g.text: Department of Computer Science & Engineering — DBMS Level 3 Experiential Learning Project
Primary Key determines each non-prime attribute (Full dependency X → Y; satisfies 2NF & 3NF with zero transitive dependencies).
Foreign Key points to the Primary Key of the referenced relation (enforced with ON DELETE CASCADE / RESTRICT).
Eventual consistency UUID reference from MongoDB NoSQL collection (gps_traces) to PostgreSQL (users).
